bedside.observations: Both panels show a two-drawer cabinet with a grey-green finish and a small lamp on top. Panel A (design) features a distinct, flared foot structure at the base. Panel B (fit) replaces the flared feet with a solid, dark rectangular plinth. The drawer pulls in Panel B appear as recessed slots, whereas Panel A shows protruding bar handles. The lamp shade in Panel B is a simple dome, while Panel A has a more complex, curved profile.
defects: The base geometry is inconsistent between the design and the fit (flared feet vs. solid plinth).
The drawer hardware is not identical; the fit version lacks the protruding handles seen in the design.
The lamp accessory does not match the design's specific shade shape.
fixes: Update the fit asset's base to match the flared foot design or vice versa.
Ensure the drawer pulls in the fit asset match the protruding bar style of the design.
Refine the lamp model in the fit asset to replicate the curved shade of the design.
